findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "why_it_worked" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_clips, get_download_link, list_social_accounts, draft_post, get_post_stats, best_time_to_post, weekly_report, search, fetch, import_photo, explain_clips, find_moments, compare_platforms, whats_taking_off, why_it_worked, get_account_stats, show_clips, show_drafts, show_report · Private data: list_projects, list_library, import_video, estimate_hu, get_download_link, preview_frame, import_photo, update_draft · Public sink: import_video, find_clips, get_download_link, list_social_accounts, draft_post, get_post_stats, best_time_to_post, plan_posts, weekly_report, import_photo, explain_clips, write_captions, update_draft, delete_draft, whats_taking_off, why_it_worked, show_drafts, show_report · Destructive: find_clips, edit_clip, style_clip, translate_captions, adjust_look, retime_clip, mix_audio, save_template, list_clipping_presets, delete_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_clips, get_download_link, list_social_accounts, draft_post, get_post_stats, best_time_to_post, weekly_report, search, fetch, import_photo, explain_clips, find_moments, compare_platforms, whats_taking_off, why_it_worked, get_account_stats, show_clips, show_drafts, show_report · Private data: list_projects, list_library, import_video, estimate_hu, get_download_link, preview_frame, import_photo, update_draft · Public sink: import_video, find_clips, get_download_link, list_social_accounts, draft_post, get_post_stats, best_time_to_post, plan_posts, weekly_report, import_photo, explain_clips, write_captions, update_draft, delete_draft, whats_taking_off, why_it_worked, show_drafts, show_report · Destructive: find_clips, edit_clip, style_clip, translate_captions, adjust_look, retime_clip, mix_audio, save_template, list_clipping_presets, delete_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
